verdict.rationale: Figma's own marketing docs describe a 'Figma agent' that can 'generate new design directions, create diagrams, edit images, search your files' from prompts, and FigJam supports prompt-driven diagram generation (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34, figma-docs-42, figma-docs-51, figma-docs-43). However, this evidence is largely thin marketing copy rather than technical documentation of prompt-to-mockup fidelity, and a community report specifically calls FigJam's AI generation features 'really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), casting doubt on real-world quality. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the design-generation agent's output quality, deeper technical documentation of the prompt-to-design pipeline, and resolution of the reported reliability issues.
